"''Yes, my child?''"
"''We have unfinished business. Attack me with all your strength.''"
[Tianris Mez and others laugh]|quoteend=0|Mae-ho Aniseya confronts Indara|audio=Mae-Indara-AttackMe-LostFound.flac|{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}}} '''Tianris Mez''' was a [[Clarodian]] who supervised a deep-mantle [[mining]] [[Mez mining operation|operation]] on the [[planet]] [[Ueda]] with his [[Gender|brother]] [[Guanlos Mez]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]], Tianris was looking to soon retire, but did not think Guanlos was ready for the responsibility. That [[Standard year|year]], the pair visited the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] in [[Point Ueda]], and Tianris sat with [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]] and several locals in the back corner. When the [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] [[Mae's quest|approached]] and demanded that Indara attack her, Tianris laughed, but when the [[Jedi]] declined, the [[assassin]] attacked Tianris's friend [[Ohal Alond]]. Tianris tried to intervene, but Aniseya knocked him out by smashing his head into the table. She then [[Indara's murder|killed]] Indara. ==Biography== {{Listen3|TianrisMez-LostFound.flac|Tianris Mez grunting|Tianris Mez grunts as he is knocked out by Mae-ho Aniseya}} [[File:Tianris-Mae-Ohal-LostFound.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Seated at a table in the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop, Tianris Mez and Ohal Alond looked up as Mae-ho Aniseya approaches and removes her hood.|Tianris Mez was sat with Indara when Mae-ho Aniseya confronted her.]] Tianris Mez was a [[Clarodian]] who supervised an old family deep-mantle [[mining]] [[Mez mining operation|operation]] in the [[Eastern Wilderness]] of the [[planet]] [[Ueda]] with his younger [[Gender|brother]], [[Guanlos Mez]], during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} Tianris was looking to soon retire and often asked [[Indara]], a [[Jedi Master]] posted on Ueda, for advice and wisdom. That [[Standard year|year]], both Tianris and Guanlos visited the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] in [[Point Ueda]], the [[capital]] [[city]] of Ueda. While Guanlos spent time at the bar, Tianris sat with Indara, his friend{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} {{AD|Disney+}} [[Ohal Alond]], and two other locals, [[Lobereki]] and [[Dyn Pilga]], at a table in the back corner of the building. While the group [[Diet|dined]], the [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] approached the table and addressed Indara, claiming they had unfinished [[Mae's quest|business]]. When the [[assassin]] lowered herself into a fighting stance and demanded the [[Jedi]] attack her, there was a moment of silence, and then Tianris began loudly laughing. The other three locals joined in, but Indara silenced them with a motion of her [[Limb|hand]] and declined to fight Aniseya, stating that Jedi did not attack the unarmed. [[File:TianrisAttacks-LostFound.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Tianris Mez grabs Mae-ho Aniseya by the shoulder as Lobereki and Dyn Pilga look on around a table in the Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop.|Tianris Mez tried to intervene when Mae-ho Aniseya attacked his friend Ohal Alond.]] Angered, Aniseya kicked Alond's chair out from underneath him and kicked him in the face. Tianris tried to intervene on behalf of his friend and grabbed Aniseya's shoulder, but she [[Unarmed combat|twisted]] him onto his knees and punched his head back before slamming it down into the table, knocking him out. Aniseya defeated Lobereki and Pilga as well before [[Indara's murder|killing]] Indara. The [[Jedi Order]] then investigated the incident. ==Personality and traits== Although he wished to retire, Tianris Mez did not think Guanlos was ready for the responsibility of managing their mining operation on his own. Tianris had [[Color|black]] [[eye]]s and skin in shades of green, purple, red, and tan. ==Equipment== While at the [[noodle]] shop, Tianris wore a simple green [[spun-moss]] [[cloak]] with a brown and red [[Clothing|tabard]], brown [[glove]]s, a brown [[belt]], and black pants. ==Behind the scenes== Tianris Mez first appeared in "[[Lost / Found]]," the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 4]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} Prior to the release of the episode, Mez was revealed in a trailer exclusively shown at [[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe]]{{CelebrationTrailer|''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''|Celebration Europe (2023)}} during the [[Lucasfilm]] Studio Showcase on [[April 7]], [[2023]].{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-lucasfilm-studio-showcase|text=SWCE 2023: 11 Highlights from Lucasfilm's Studio Showcase}} Costume concept illustrator [[Sophie Fretwell]] created a design for Tianris Mez titled "Costume Concept for a Horned Alien."''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' The scenes in the shop were filmed at
